overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the June 28 meeting was held in person at an open, accessible City Hall room, so the notice need not list remote access.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Parks and Recreation Committee's June 28 meeting notice did not contain information on the availability of remote access.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law here where it provided in-person access.
